text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Massacre of civilians in the southern Laghouat region.
- Health Ministry reviews hospitals management: the diagnosis is damning.
- One year after the killing of 18 civilians in Laghouat, more citizens fall victim of a new massacre there.
- Algeria celebrates its national Diplomacy Day.
- The Transitional National Council will vote a party law to establish a genuine democracy.
- Terrorists kill several civilians in Laghouat: sheer slaughter perpetrated on Monday night by an armed terrorist group.
